subject: Re: Lightweight Interop Gateway — ISV pilot & tracing plan
messages:
From: Samir Kapoor <samir@toolforge.ai>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: Lily Chen <lily@langweave.io>
Date: 2028-04-11T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Lightweight Interop Gateway — pilot idea

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for taking a quick call with us earlier. ToolForge has been building a lightweight interop gateway that sits between frameworks (LangChain/LlamaIndex) and inference runtimes to provide consistent tracing, prefix-caching, and model-variant fallback at the SDK layer. We think a narrow pilot with Redwood could demonstrate measurable latency and token-cost wins while preserving trace fidelity for our partners.

High-level asks from our side:
- Quick technical validation with Redwood's hosted runtime for trace hooks and token attribution.
- A 2-week sandbox where we run a small set of prompts (1k/day) against a pinned model variant.
- Agreement on telemetry schema and a shared SLI for end-to-end latency and token accuracy.

I've attached a short proposal (lw-gateway-proposal-v1.pdf) and an interop matrix. If this looks interesting we can sign the MOU (DocuSign link in the attached) and schedule a kickoff.

Happy to sync next week — available Tue/Wed morning PT.

Best,
Samir
Co-founder, ToolForge
attachments: lw-gateway-proposal-v1.pdf (application/pdf); interop-matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: Samir Kapoor <samir@toolforge.ai>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, Lily Chen <lily@langweave.io>
Date: 2028-04-11T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Lightweight Interop Gateway — pilot idea

Samir — thanks for the clear proposal and the materials. This aligns well with what our ecosystem team has been asking for: a low-friction way to get SDK-level observability without forcing a full runtime integration.

Quick notes:
- We can provision a sandbox on our hosted API for a 2-week pilot; please confirm which model family and sequence lengths you expect.
- Telemetry: Redwood can emit trace IDs and per-request token accounting (prompt / completion / cached tokens) via a small JSON payload. We need to agree on field names to avoid mapping work on your side.
- Tracing: We prefer the OpenTelemetry span model with an additional span attribute "rw.sdk.trace_hook" to mark SDK-level instrumentation.

Vanessa — can you help scope a lightweight SLA (latency percentile) and confirm sandbox capacity?
Marissa — I want engineering + solutions on the kickoff; can you volunteer a point person to run the telemetry sync and the eval harness?

Proposed next step: 30m sync Wed 4/12 10:00 PT. If that works, Samir/Lily can send an attendee list and we'll circulate a short agenda.

- Mateo
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
attachments: (none)

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-11T14:28:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Lightweight Interop Gateway — pilot idea

Forwarding for visibility. Mateo: sandbox capacity is fine — we can provide a dev pool (1 GPU equivalent) that should be enough for 1k/day tests.

Marissa: for the telemetry mapping call, let's make sure we include:
- definitive field list for token accounting (prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, cached_tokens)
- the per-span attributes we will require for SDK hooks
- a sample payload and small validation script (we can host in the shared drive)

One operational ask: if ToolForge intends to exercise fallback to smaller quantized models under load, we need to confirm which model variants are allowed inside the pilot and whether customer prompts contain PII — that will affect data retention/audit log settings.

I'll be on the Wed sync and can bring the SLA sketch.

— Vanessa
Director, Ecosystem Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: Lily Chen <lily@langweave.io>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai, Samir Kapoor <samir@toolforge.ai>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-13T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Lightweight Interop Gateway — pilot idea

Thanks everyone for a productive sync today. Following up with the action items and a short mutual action plan.

Summary of what we agreed on:
1) Sandbox: Redwood to provision a hosted sandbox (dev pool) for ToolForge, duration 14 days, start date 2028-04-18. Model: rw-llama-2-13b (float16) with a quantized fallback to rw-llama-2-7b-q4_0 for burst scenarios. Sequence lengths: prompt <= 512 tokens, completion <= 256 tokens.
2) Telemetry schema: agreed fields — trace_id, span_id, parent_span_id, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, cached_tokens, rw.sdk.trace_hook (boolean), model_variant, latency_ms. Marissa to post a sample payload and a validation script to the shared drive by EOD 4/14.
3) Evaluation: ToolForge will run 1k requests/day using a shared prompt set (we'll provide) and tag responses with a small eval rubric (latency, repeatability, token-accounting parity).
4) Legal/MOU: Samir to route the MOU via DocuSign. We'll issue a pilot access token scoped to the sandbox and an SLA note (p95 < 450ms) for the pilot.

Attachments sent: lw-gateway-proposal-v1.pdf; interop-matrix.xlsx; docusign-mou.pdf (Samir — thanks for routing).

Next steps (owners + dates):
- Samir: send DocuSign by 4/14 (ToolForge)
- Marissa: upload sample telemetry payload + validation script by 4/14 (Redwood)
- Vanessa: post sandbox access and token by 4/17 (Redwood infra)
- Mateo: coordinate kickoff and publish shared agenda by 4/15

Looking forward to the pilot — please reply if any of the items above need correction.

Best,
Lily Chen
Head of Integrations, LangWeave
